roles.name: --border
roles.purpose: frames and lines: a 2px frame on a resting container and the splits between its sections, a 1px line on controls and between rows

roles.name: --card
roles.purpose: a resting container that holds content, framed by a 2px border

roles.name: --gap-default
roles.purpose: field to field, block to block, card to card
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-body
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-heading
roles.purpose: card, section and surface headings, and the text typed into a field
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --muted-foreground
roles.purpose: secondary text — hints, metadata. L .50 is the lightest that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface muted text sits on, muted and accent included

roles.name: --radius-container
roles.purpose: a container that HOLDS content: a card, a dialog, a menu

roles.name: --shadow-sheet
roles.purpose: a card risen from the bottom edge of the screen — a bottom sheet — casts its shadow upward; the approved design value

roles.name: --step-14
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-18
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-body
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-heading
roles.purpose: a card or section heading, a readout caption, a figure, initials
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: border-frame
roles.purpose: The two line roles — every border is one of them, by its job (design.md → Elevation & Depth). A frame (2px) is a container's edge and the splits and header bands between its sections. A line (1px) is a control's edge, an overlay's edge, and the rules between rows or items. Use these — never a numbered border width.

roles.name: edge-panel
roles.purpose: A panel that rises from the bottom edge of the screen — a bottom sheet: its content stays clear of a phone's home indicator.

roles.name: type-body
roles.purpose: prose — descriptions, list text, dialog text
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-14); font-weight: var(--weight-body); line-height: var(--line-height-body)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-card-title
roles.purpose: the title of a card — the name of the whole card, a step above a heading inside it
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-18); font-weight: var(--weight-heading); line-height: var(--line-height-heading)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.
